description: Language-model benchmark on the assistant's real job. Each case is rendered with the app's own prompts. 'context': 'app' uses the app's knowledge retrieval for the question; a 'records' list selects records from knowledge_base/personal_data.json by [category, record_type, owner] (for controlled reasoning tests); 'memory', 'earlier' and 'online_facts' fill the matching prompt sections. Scoring is case-insensitive regex: every 'all' pattern and at least one 'any' pattern must match, and no 'forbid' pattern may.
